_about: The owner's answers given in the chat rather than in the questionnaire (same keys; a questionnaire answer wins). Keep adding here.
chat.2026-11-21.aviary: The Glass Aviary is really the best room so far.
chat.2026-11-21.minigames: Minigames are super fun, like playing the music or navigating through the labyrinth. Could add more 'gaming' in future rooms, combining easy coordination with knowledge from clues.
chat.2026-11-21.size: The longer and larger a room, the more time the easier puzzles take: finding the right spots and building an overview of everything in the room.
chat.2026-11-21.setting: The setting/theme of a room matters a lot for the fun; the bird room was a big one in that regard.
chat.2026-11-21.stars: Targets of 1.3 times the owner's time are too generous: not everything should get three stars.
